# THIRD UPDATE: This note was updated again via API!

## 🦀 Overview
A systems programming language focused on safety, speed, and concurrency without a garbage collector.

### 🔒 Core Features
- **Memory Safety**: Eliminates common bugs like null pointers, buffer overflows, and data races at compile time.
- **Zero-Cost Abstractions**: High-level features that compile down to efficient machine code.
- **Concurrency Made Easy**: Fearless concurrency through ownership, borrowing, and lifetimes.

### 🛠️ Tooling & Ecosystem
- **Cargo**: Built-in package manager and build system (like npm/maven but integrated).
- **Crates.io**: Official repository for thousands of reusable libraries.
- **IDE Support**: Excellent integration with VS Code, IntelliJ, and Rust Analyzer.

### 🚀 Best Use Cases
- System programming & operating systems
- WebAssembly (WASM) modules
- High-performance networking & CLI tools
- Embedded systems & blockchain
- Performance-critical game engines & servers

*Known for its steep learning curve but highly rewarding for reliability and performance.*

# Unity

## 🎮 Overview
The most popular cross-platform game engine used by millions of developers to create 2D, 3D, AR, and VR experiences.

### ⚙️ Core Technologies
- **C# Scripting**: High-level language used for game logic, widely adopted for its readability and performance.
- **Component-Based Architecture**: Entities built using GameObjects and Components for modular design.
- **Mono & IL2CPP**: Dual scripting backend system for flexibility and optimized performance on mobile/console.

### 🚀 Key Features
- **Asset Store**: Massive marketplace with plugins, 3D models, audio, and complete toolkits.
- **2D & 3D Support**: Unified editor for both 2D (Tilemap, Sprite tools) and 3D development.
- **XR Support**: Built-in support for ARKit, ARCore, OpenXR, and VR/AR device SDKs.
- **Visual Effects**: Shader Graph, VFX Graph, and Particle System for creating stunning visuals without heavy coding.

### 📱 Deployment & Platforms
- **25+ Platforms**: Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, WebGL, Consoles (PS, Xbox, Switch), and Smart TVs.
- **Mobile First**: Optimized build pipelines specifically for Android and iOS performance constraints.
- **Cloud Build**: Automated build system for continuous integration and delivery.

### 🛠️ Tools & Workflow
- **Hubs & Collaboration**: Unity Collaborate (legacy) and Unity Version Control (Perforce-based) for team workflows.
- **Analytics & Testing**: Integrated Analytics, Testing Framework, and Remote Config for live ops management.
- **Visual Scripting**: Node-based visual scripting (Visual Scripting formerly Bolt) for designers and non-programmers.

### 💡 Best For
- Mobile game development
- Indie and AA game projects
- AR/VR experiences
- Prototyping and education
- Cross-platform deployment strategies

# Unreal Engine 5 (UE5)

## 🚀 Overview
Epic Games' latest iteration of their flagship real-time 3D creation tool, designed for high-fidelity visuals and scalable workflows.

### 🔥 Core Technologies
- **Nanite**: Virtualized geometry system enabling cinematic film quality and massive detail levels without performance loss.
- **Lumen**: Fully dynamic global illumination and reflection system, reacting instantly to changes in geometry or lighting.

### 🎮 Features
- **World Partition**: Auto-streams the entire open world for the player while automatically managing data for the editor.
- **Chaos Physics**: Advanced physics simulation for destruction, vehicle physics, and cloth.
- **MetaHuman**: Cloud-based character creation tool for generating realistic human faces and bodies.

### 🛠️ Development Tools
- **Blueprints**: Visual scripting system allowing rapid prototyping without traditional coding.
- **Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN)**: New creator tools allowing game development within Fortnite.
- **Remaster Tools**: AI-driven tools to automatically upgrade assets from older engines to UE5 standards.

### 📱 Deployment & Platforms
- **Next-Gen Consoles**: Optimized for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam Deck.
- **PC**: Supports high-end hardware for maximum fidelity.
- **Mobile & VR/AR**: Growing support for mobile ports and immersive experiences.
- **Architecture**: C++ and Blueprint-based workflow.

### 💡 Best For
- AAA and AAAA game development
- Open-world games
- Real-time 3D experiences (film, architecture, automotive)
- Projects requiring high-fidelity graphics out of the box

## Godot 4 Overview
A complete rewrite of the engine focused on performance, modern rendering, and developer experience.

### 🎨 Rendering & Performance
- **Vulkan-only backend**: Switched from OpenGL to Vulkan for better multi-threading, modern graphics APIs, and consistent cross-platform behavior.
- **Advanced Lighting**: Real-time SDFGI (signed-distance field global illumination), SSR2, baked/lightmap GPU rendering, and volumetric fog.
- **Multithreaded Rendering**: Parallel command generation and improved draw call batching for higher FPS on mid-to-high-end hardware.
- **GPU-driven rendering**: Instanced rendering, modern material system with Shader Globals and uniform buffers.

### 🌍 3D Engine Improvements
- **glTF 2.0 Import/Export**: Native support for industry-standard 3D asset pipeline.
- **Skeletal Animation**: New AnimationPlayer, AnimationMixer, and improved skeleton/bone system.
- **Physics & Collision**: RigidBody3D and CharacterBody3D redesign, better collision shapes, and improved navigation meshes.
- **Lighting & Shadows**: Per-light shadows, PCF soft shadows, and improved SSAO/SSR.

### 🛠️ Tools & Editor
- **Redesigned UI**: More responsive editor layout, customizable theme, and improved node/property editors.
- **GDExtension**: C/C++/Rust plugins without recompiling the engine (replaces older C# integration).
- **C# Support**: First-class C# with .NET 6/7/8, improved IL2CPP export, and native plugin support.
- **New Debugging**: Better profiler, visual debugger, and remote scene tree inspection.

### 📦 2D & UI
- **CanvasItem Modernization**: Improved rendering pipeline for 2D, better texture atlasing, and GPU acceleration.
- **UI System**: Enhanced Control nodes, improved layout containers, and better localization (i18n) tools.
- **Animation & Visuals**: 2D skeletal animation, improved shaders, and particle system enhancements.

### 🚀 Deployment & Ecosystem
- **Export Presets**: Streamlined build pipeline for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, Web (WASM), and consoles (via partners).
- **Asset Library**: Built-in editor asset browser with community/publisher assets.
- **Cross-Platform Consistency**: Single codebase with minimal platform-specific tweaks needed.
- **Open Source & Free**: MIT licensed, no royalties, fully transparent development.

### 💡 Best For
- Indie & AA game development
- 2D, 3D, and hybrid projects
- Rapid prototyping & educational use
- Teams wanting open, extensible tooling

*Godot 4 is a major leap forward, especially for performance-conscious and modern-graphics projects.*

# Shadow Court — Role Design Prompt

You are helping design **new roles** for a chaos-oriented social deduction game called **Shadow Court**, inspired by Mafia, Werewolf, and Town of Salem.

The game is built inside **Genshin Impact – Miliastra Wonderland (UGC)**, so all role ideas must be realistic for a restricted node-based scripting environment.

The goal is to create roles that produce **social deduction, deception, uncertainty, role interactions, and memorable situations**, while remaining simple enough to implement.

---

# Platform Constraints

* Node-based scripting only; no traditional coding.
* Very limited processing power.
* Even small loops can fail, so role logic must remain extremely lightweight.
* No custom assets.
* Only existing Genshin/Miliastra assets, effects, music, and SFX.
* Cannot modify player avatars.
* Cannot modify matchmaking or lobby systems.
* Cannot manipulate, modify, fake, or silence chat messages.
* Players generally cannot visit other players.
* Roles normally operate from their own role rooms.
* One special role may use a visit mechanic if it is simple enough to implement.
* Avoid mechanics requiring complicated physical movement or interaction.

---

# Player Count

Matches contain **5–8 players**.

* **5–6 players → 1 killer**
* **7–8 players → 2 killers**

Roles must work properly with both 1 and 2 killers.

---

# Game Structure

## Starting Day

The match begins during Day Phase.

Players stand in the center ring and ready up.

A 10-second countdown starts the game.

## Night Phase

* Players return to their role rooms.
* Players select/use their abilities from their rooms.
* Killers select their targets.
* Roles generally cannot physically visit other players.

## Day Phase

* Death results are revealed.
* Living players gather in the Court Hall.
* Players discuss for approximately 4 minutes.
* Players then enter the voting phase.

## Voting

* Players vote for a player to execute.
* The player with the highest votes is normally executed.
* Certain existing roles can override or prevent execution.

---

# Death System

When a normal player dies, their active role logic is removed.

Therefore, avoid mechanics that require a dead player's role to continue executing logic.

Some special dead-state roles exist.

## Ghost

* Is a dead player.
* Cannot be seen by living players.
* Cannot talk with living players.
* Can talk with other dead players.
* Has no normal role ability.

## Echo

* Is a resurrected dead player.
* Appears as an **angel** to living players.
* Living players cannot tell whether an angel is an Echo or CursedEcho.
* Can vote.
* Cannot use abilities.
* Can talk with dead players.
* Cannot talk with living players through global chat.
* Can be killed again.
* Wins with the **Good faction**.

## CursedEcho

* Works mechanically like Echo.
* Appears as the same angel to living players.
* Living players cannot distinguish it from a Good Echo.
* Can vote.
* Has no abilities.
* Can talk with dead players.
* Cannot talk with living players.
* Can be killed again.
* Wins with the **Killer faction**.

This creates an important existing deception mechanic: **a resurrected angel may secretly be working for either side.**

---

# Existing Roles

These roles are **already implemented/existing**. Do not suggest them again as new role ideas unless specifically discussing improvements or variants.

## Civilian

* No special ability.
* Wins with the Good faction.

## Assassin

* Killer role.
* Once per game, performs a guaranteed kill.
* The kill ignores protection.

## Deceiver

* Evil role.
* Appears **Good/innocent** to Oracle.
* Once per game, can select a target who appears **Killer/Evil** to Oracle for that night.

## Echo

* Good dead-state role.
* See Death System above.

## CursedEcho

* Killer-aligned dead-state role.
* See Death System above.

## Ghost

* Dead player.
* Invisible to living players.
* Can only communicate with other dead players.

## Healer

* Protects one player each night.
* Can self-heal once per game.

## Jailer

* Jails one player during the day.
* Jail protects the target from attacks.
* Jail blocks the target's ability.
* **Werewolf can break out of jail.**

## Jester

* Neutral role.
* Wins if executed by vote.

## King

* Has no special ability before revelation.
* When the King is revealed, their vote has **double voting power**.

## Knight

* Protects one player at night.
* If that player is attacked, the Knight dies instead.

## Medium

* Has access to the ghost room.
* Can use their ability from there.
* Can see and communicate with ghosts.
* Has this ability once per game.

## Oracle

* Checks one player per day.
* Receives only whether that player has a **Good Aura or Evil Aura**.
* Does not receive the exact role.

## Priest

* Once per game, can revive one dead player.
* The revived player becomes an **Echo**.

## Revenant

* Must be killed twice.
* First death → resurrects as **CursedEcho**.
* Second death → permanently dies.

## Vampire

* Killer role.
* Captures/jails one target at night.
* The target is protected from attacks and their ability is blocked.
* Has no additional effect beyond this.

## Werewolf

* Killer role.
* Can break out of Jailer/Vampire-style jail.

## Amnesiac

* On Day 2, chooses one dead player.
* Copies that dead player's role.

## Gravekeeper

* At night, can check the role of one dead player.
* Receives the dead player's role information.

## Chronomancer

* During the voting phase, freezes all other players while remaining unfrozen themselves.
* Because everyone else is frozen, **nobody can vote that day**.
* This is the Chronomancer's purpose.

## High Judge

During an execution, can choose one of two actions:

* **Cancel the execution**, or
* **Execute one player.**

The High Judge's decision cannot be overruled by anyone, including the King.

---

# Future Roles Already Liked

These are **future role candidates**, not currently implemented roles.

## Witness

When killed, reveals the ID of one killer.

## Monster Hunter

A two-stage investigative role.

**Stage 1:**

* Detects which evil roles are present in the current match.

**Stage 2:**

* After correctly identifying an evil role, can track down which player has that role.

The role should feel like **detecting supernatural creatures and then hunting them**, rather than simply being another Oracle.

## Inquisitor

Once per match, publicly reveals one player's exact role.

Unlike Oracle, the information is revealed to **everyone**.

## Confessor

The one planned exception to the normal no-visit rule.

* Can visit one player at night.
* If that player is attacked by a killer, the Confessor dies instead of the intended target.
* The target survives.

## Purifier

Once per game, can remove an evil player's alignment and turn them into a civilian.

The exact interaction with the player's original role should be designed carefully.

## Usurper

* Neutral/other faction role.
* If the King dies, the Usurper becomes the new King.

## Evil Investigator

* Evil-aligned investigative role.
* Can check one player at night.
* Can learn their Good-role category or potentially their exact role.
* Must remain meaningfully different from Oracle.

## Traitor

* Wins if the Killer faction wins.
* Does **not** know who the killers are.
* Can therefore accidentally help the Good faction while trying to achieve their own victory.

## Executioner

* Receives a secret target.
* Wins if that specific player is executed.

## Cursed

* If attacked by a killer, the attacker dies instead.
* The exact interaction with protection and multiple killers should be balanced carefully.

## Plaguebearer

* Infects one player each night.
* Infection is delayed.
* An infected player dies after several days unless healed.
* The delay is an important part of the role.

## Possessor

* At night, possesses one player.
* Prevents that player from using their ability.
* Should remain lightweight and should not require actual player movement/control.

## Scapegoat

* Once per game.
* When the Scapegoat would be executed, they can cause another player to be executed instead.

## Istaroth — Ruler of Time

* Genshin-inspired role based on Istaroth.
* Once per game, can manipulate time.
* Intended concept: **rewind the game by approximately one day**, potentially reversing events that occurred during that period.
* This is potentially extremely powerful and must be designed carefully around the existing death, role, voting, and phase systems.
* Do not assume a technically complex full game-state rollback is possible; design a lightweight implementation if developing this role.

---

# Role Design Requirements

New roles must:

* Work with **5–8 players**.
* Work with either 1 or 2 killers.
* Be implementable with lightweight node logic.
* Avoid heavy loops.
* Avoid complicated state tracking.
* Avoid general player visits.
* Avoid chat manipulation.
* Avoid requiring dead players to run complex logic.
* Avoid complex physical movement mechanics.
* Use simple variables, IDs, flags, timers, role states, phase checks, and existing game events where possible.
* Create meaningful discussion.
* Encourage bluffing and counter-bluffing.
* Create uncertainty without making the game feel random or unfair.
* Have understandable rules and counterplay.

---

# Preferred Role Mechanics

Good mechanics include:

* Information manipulation
* False or incomplete information
* Conditional role reveals
* Public role reveals
* Voting consequences
* Voting power changes
* Alignment changes
* Role copying
* Role inheritance
* Secret objectives
* Alternate win conditions
* Delayed effects
* Death interactions
* Limited-use powerful abilities
* Faction switching
* Abilities that become stronger or change after certain events
* Roles that interact with existing roles
* Roles that create conflicting incentives
* Roles that make players question whether another player is telling the truth

---

# Avoid Generic Roles

Do not simply create another:

* Oracle-style investigator
* Knight-style protector
* Healer-style protector
* Jailer-style blocker
* Normal killer
* Basic role blocker
* Basic role reveal

New roles should have a **distinct reason to exist**.

The ideal role should make players say:

> "Wait, that can happen?"

rather than:

> "Oh, that's just another investigator."

---

# Social Deduction Goal

Shadow Court is intentionally **chaotic**.

The goal is not perfect information or perfectly predictable faction balance.

Players should have to reason about:

* Who is lying?
* Which information is trustworthy?
* Why did someone protect another player?
* Why did someone vote that way?
* Why did someone want a particular player alive?
* Did a role actually work as claimed?
* Did someone's faction change?
* Is the person claiming a role actually that role?
* Is an apparently Good player secretly helping Evil?
* What happened to a player after they died?
* Can a resurrected player actually be trusted?

Roles should create situations where **player behavior itself becomes evidence**.

---

# Genshin / Shadow Court Theme

Roles can be inspired by Genshin characters, lore, gods, factions, supernatural concepts, and titles.

Examples of thematic inspiration include:

* Istaroth — Time
* Ronova — Death
* Abyssal powers
* Fatui
* Divine beings
* Curses
* Spirits
* Prophecy
* Resurrection
* Ancient gods
* Celestial powers

However, **mechanical quality is more important than forcing a Genshin reference**.

A role can have a completely original name if its mechanic is excellent.

---

# Important Design Principle

When suggesting new roles, first compare them against the **entire existing role list**.

Do not accidentally recreate something that already exists.

The role should add a **new gameplay dimension**, not merely rename an existing mechanic.

Keep mechanics simple enough for Miliastra UGC while making them unusual enough to create memorable social-deduction situations.

# Genshin Impact: Elemental Reactions Overview

## Overview
**Elemental Reactions** are triggered by applying certain combinations of elemental effects on a target (enemies, players, or objects). When an element is applied to a target, it creates an elemental aura that decays over time. A reaction occurs when a second element is applied onto a target with an existing elemental aura.

*   **Mechanism:** Triggering reactions consumes the existing aura, shortening its duration or removing it entirely depending on the reaction type.
*   **Cooldown:** Many sources of elemental damage have an Internal Cooldown and may not be able to trigger reactions on every hit.
*   **Damage Scaling:** Reaction damage can be increased by the **Elemental Mastery (EM)** of the character causing the reaction.
    *   *Transformative/Additive:* Base Damage + EM multiplier.
    *   *Amplifying:* Attack Damage Multiplier + EM multiplier.

### Reaction Matrix
The following table outlines the interactions based on the First Element applied and the Second Element applied.

| First Element \ Second Element | Hydro | Electro | Dendro | Cryo | Anemo | Geo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pyro** | Vaporize (2×) | Overloaded (2×) | Burning (1.5×) | Melt (2×) | Swirl | Crystallize |
| **Hydro** | — | Electro-Charged | Bloom | Frozen | Swirl | Crystallize |
| **Electro** | — | — | Quicken | Superconduct | Swirl | Stellar-Conduct |
| **Cryo** | — | — | — | — | Swirl | Shatter |
| **Dendro** | — | — | — | — | Swirl | — |
| **Anemo** | — | — | — | — | — | — |
| **Geo** | — | — | — | — | — | — |

*Note: Specific multipliers and interactions (e.g., Vaporize 1.5× vs 2×, Melt 1.5× vs 2×) depend on the order of elements.*

---

## Reaction Categories

### Transformative Reactions
*   **Reactions:** Overloaded, Shattered, Electro-Charged, Superconduct, Swirl, Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon.
*   **Mechanics:**
    *   Deal their own instances of damage (separate from triggering attacks).
    *   Base Damage determined by reaction type and character level.
    *   Multiplied by a percentage determined by **Elemental Mastery (EM)**.
    *   **Cannot Crit.**
    *   Ignored target's DEF (except for a negligible multiplier).
    *   Affected by Resistance.

### Amplifying Reactions
*   **Reactions:** Vaporize, Melt.
*   **Mechanics:**
    *   Do not deal damage of their own.
    *   Multiply the damage of the attacks triggering them by **2×** or **1.5×**.
        *   **2× (Forward):** Consumes more initial element; often removes the aura immediately.
        *   **1.5× (Reverse):** Consumes less initial element; often preserves the aura.
    *   Damage is multiplied by a percentage determined by **Elemental Mastery (EM)**.

### Additive Reactions (Catalyze Reactions)
*   **Reactions:** Spread, Aggravate.
*   **Mechanics:**
    *   Increase the DMG of the hit that triggers it without dealing DMG of their own.
    *   Provide an **Additive Base DMG Bonus** (adds to base DMG instead of multiplying).
    *   Spread provides a slightly higher Additive Base DMG Bonus than Aggravate.

### Lunar Reactions
*   **Reactions:** Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, Lunar-Crystallize.
*   **Mechanics:**
    *   Can be dealt directly by a talent or through a separate instance of damage involving all contributing characters' stats.
    *   Base Damage determined by reaction type and character level.
    *   Multiplied by Base DMG Bonus from **Moonsign Benediction Passives** and **Elemental Mastery (EM) percentage**.
    *   **Ignores DMG Bonus and target's DEF**, but affected by Resistance.

### Stellar Reactions
*   **Reactions:** Stellar-Conduct.
*   **Mechanics:**
    *   Dealt directly by a character's talent.
    *   Base Damage multiplied by Base DMG Bonus from passives and **Elemental Mastery (EM) percentage**.
    *   **Ignores DMG Bonus and target's DEF**, but affected by Resistance.

---

## Talents with Reaction Effects
Characters with 16+ Talents that trigger special effects on reactions.

| Character | Talent | Description | Type |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nahida** | All Schemes to Know | Enters Aiming Mode (Select up to 8 opponents). Release deals Dendro DMG and marks with Seed of Skandha. Tri-Karma Purification triggers on reaction or Dendro Core hit. | Elemental Skill |
| **Kaveh** | An Architect's Undertaking | Dendro Core (including Hyperbloom/Burgeon) hits Kaveh = 300% EM HP Regen. | 1st Ascension Passive |
| **Dori** | An Eye for Gold | Party triggers specific reactions = Spirit-Warding Lamp CD decreased by 1s. | 1st Ascension Passive |
| **Sethos** | Ancient Rite: The Thundering Sands | Electro Skill triggers specific reactions = Recover Elemental Energy. | Elemental Skill |
| **Sucrose** | Catalyst Conversion | Sucrose triggers Swirl = Party matching element EM +50 for 8s. | 1st Ascension Passive |
| **Diona** | Choice Treasures | Party triggers Superconduct/Stellar-Conduct/Cryo Swirl after Icy Paws = Fire 3 Icy Paws. | Witch's Revelation Passive |
| **Clorinde** | Dark-Shattering Flame | Party triggers Electro reaction = Clorinde Normal/Plunge ATK DMG +20% of ATK (Max 1800). | 1st Ascension Passive |
| **Collei** | Floral Sidewinder | Party triggers Burning/Quicken/Aggravate/Spread/Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon/Burning = Character gains Sprout (3s Dendro DMG). | 1st Ascension Passive |
| **Neuvillette** | Heir to the Ancient Sea's Authority | Party triggers specific reactions = Past Draconic Glories stacks. Charged Attack DMG increased by 110%/125%/160%. | 1st Ascension Passive |
| **Qiqi** | Life-Prolonging Methods | Party triggers reaction under Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost = Incoming Healing +20%. | 1st Ascension Passive |
| **Ororon** | Nightshade Synesthesia | Specific reaction triggers = Nightsoul points gain or Hypersense Electro DMG. | 1st Ascension Passive |
| **Shikanoin Heizou** | Paradoxical Practice | Heizou activates Swirl = Heartstopper Strike stacks. | 1st Ascension Passive |
| **Kaedehara Kazuha** | Poetics of Fuubutsu | Kazuha triggers Swirl = Party DMG Bonus based on EM. | 4th Ascension Passive |
| **Sayu** | Someone More Capable | Sayu triggers Swirl = Heal Party (300 HP + 1.2 HP/EM). | 1st Ascension Passive |
| **Collei** | The Languid Wood | Party triggers Burning/Quicken/Aggravate/Spread/Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon/Burning = Cuilein-Anbar Zone duration +1s. | 4th Ascension Passive |
| **Fischl** | Undone Be Thy Sinful Hex | Active triggers Electro reaction = Thundering Retribution (80% ATK Electro DMG). | 4th Ascension Passive |
| **Baizhu** | All Things Are of the Earth | Party healed by Seamless Shields = Burning/Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon +2% DMG; Lunar-Bloom +0.7%; Aggravate/Spread Bonus +0.8%. | 4th Ascension Passive |
| **Kaveh** | Artistic Ingenuity | Mehrak radial scan deals AoE Dendro DMG and bursts Dendro Cores. | Elemental Skill |
| **Ineffa** | Assemblage Hub | Electro-Charged converted to Lunar-Charged. DMG increased by 0.7% per 100 ATK. Moonsign +1. | Moonsign Benediction |
| **Nilou** | Court of Dancing Petals | Party Dendro/Hydro = Golden Chalice's Bounty. Bloom/Lunar-Bloom creates Bountiful Cores. | 1st Ascension Passive |
| **Nilou** | Dreamy Dance of Aeons | Bountiful Core DMG +9% per 1,000 Max HP above 30,000. Max 400%. | 4th Ascension Passive |
| **Linnea** | Habitat Survey | Hydro Crystallize converted to Lunar-Crystallize. DMG increased by 0.7% per 100 DEF. Moonsign +1. | Moonsign Benediction |
| **Sandrone** | Light of Rationalisme | Superconduct changed to Stellar-Conduct. DMG increased by 0.7% per 100 ATK. | Passive |
| **Columbina** | Moonlight, Lent Unto You | Specific reactions converted to Lunar Reactions. Lunar DMG +0.2% per 1,000 Max HP. Moonsign +1. | Moonsign Benediction |
| **Flins** | Old World Secrets | Electro-Charged converted to Lunar-Charged. DMG +0.7% per 100 ATK. Moonsign +1. | Moonsign Benediction |
| **Kaveh** | Painted Dome | Enhanced combat abilities. Dendro Cores from Bloom/Lunar-Bloom deal additional DMG. | Elemental Burst |
| **Zibai** | The Coursing Sun and Moon | Hydro Crystallize converted to Lunar-Crystallize. DMG increased by 0.7% per 100 DEF. Moonsign +1. | Passive |

---

## Constellations with Reaction Effects
*   **Keqing (Attunement):** Electro reaction = +25% ATK for 10s. (C4)
*   **Collei (Through Hill and Copse):** Floral Ring grants Sprout. Extended duration if party triggers Burning/Quicken/Aggravate/Spread/Bloom/Lunar-Bloom/Burgeon. (C2)
*   **Tighnari (Withering Glimpsed in the Leaves):** Fashioner's Tanglevine Shaft triggers Burning/Bloom/Lunar-Bloom/Quicken/Spread = +60 EM for party. (C4)
*   **Cyno (Austerity: Forbidding Guard):** Pactsworn Pathclearer triggers specific reactions = Restore 3 EM Energy (Max 5 times). (C4)

notes.description:
Refined co-op plan with a tight, casual-first loop and clear pacing.

---

## Core Loop (finalized)

**Start → Night 1 (hook) → Day → Night → Day → … → End**

* Start at **Night 1** (easy, fun combat immediately)
* Alternate **short Day (2–3 min)** and **Night (2–4 min target)**
* Run ends after ~5–7 nights or on base defeat

---

## Night Phase (Action / Retention Driver)

**Goals**

* Keep players active every second
* Create “almost lost” moments

**Player Actions**

* Bow / mage abilities (no setup)
* Repair walls, reload towers
* Reposition, respond to threats

**Systems**

* Waves come in bursts (not infinite trickle)
* Clear end condition: “Defeat all waves”

**Escalation**

* N1: basic enemies
* N2–3: faster / ranged
* N4–5: armored / mini-boss
* (light randomness each night)

**Rules**

* Towers assist, don’t carry
* Players must matter

---

## Day Phase (2–3 minutes, no downtime)

Pick **one primary economy** to keep it simple.

### Option A — Gold-Only (recommended for MVP)

* Players earn gold via:

  * Quick tasks (10–20s each)
  * Small combat rewards from last night
* Spend gold on:

  * Towers
  * Wall upgrades
  * Weapon upgrades

**Task Types**

* Chore (earn gold): “clear debris”, “deliver crate”
* Build (cost gold): “place tower”, “upgrade wall”

### Option B — Light Gathering (optional later)

* Small map, 2–3 resource nodes (wood/ore)
* Instant collection (no tools)
* Convert to gold automatically at base

**Avoid mixing both deeply in MVP.**

---

## First 60 Seconds (critical)

* Spawn in base during **Night 1**
* Give:

  * Bow + one ability
* UI:

  * “Defend the camp!”
* Enemies arrive quickly (5–10s)

After Night 1:

* Day UI appears:

  * “Earn gold → Build before night”

No tutorial needed.

---

## Player Independence (your requirement)

* Everyone can:

  * Gather/earn
  * Build
  * Fight
* Optional soft boosts later (not required for MVP)

---

## Map Design

* **Small, centralized**
* One base area
* 2–3 nearby task spots
* No long travel

Forces natural convergence.

---

## Progression per Run

* Earn → Spend → Survive → Repeat
* Visible improvements:

  * Stronger towers
  * Faster kills
  * More enemies handled

---

## Session Target

* 10–15 minutes total
* 5–7 nights max
* Fast restart loop

---

## What to Avoid (important)

* No tool crafting (axe/pickaxe)
* No equipment management
* No long chains (refine → craft → build)
* No idle waiting

---

## Minimal MVP Feature List

* Bow + 1 ability
* 2 tower types
* 3 enemy types
* Gold economy (tasks + spend)
* 1 map
* 5 nights progression

---

## Why This Works

* Starts with action (hook)
* Day is short and purposeful
* No dependency on teammates
* Constant feedback (earn/spend/fight)
* Fits casual + random players

---

## Next Step (recommended)

Define:

* **Exact 3–4 Day tasks**
* **2 tower types + costs**
* **Night 1–5 enemy composition**

This locks scope and lets you build immediately.

Elemental Reversi is a strategic 1v1 board game where Cryo  and Pyro  compete to control the board. Players take turns placing tiles and converting the opponent’s pieces by sandwiching them between their own. The match ends when the board is full — the player with the most tiles wins.

---

Elemental Reversi takes place on a floating elemental arena where two players battle for board control. One player represents Cryo , the other Pyro . The board can be played in different sizes (4×4, 6×6, or 8×8), changing the length and strategy of the match.

Players alternate turns placing one tile at a time on the board. A move is valid only if it sandwiches one or more opponent tiles between two of your own in a straight line (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal). All trapped tiles are immediately converted to your element.

As the match progresses, control of the board shifts constantly as tiles change ownership. Positioning is important — corners and edges are especially powerful because they cannot be converted once secured.

The game ends when the board is completely filled or no valid moves remain. At that point the tiles are counted. The player controlling the most tiles wins the match. If both players control the same number of tiles, the match ends in a draw.

Choose your board size, plan your moves carefully, and dominate the battlefield with Cryo or Pyro.

Game Info
A fantasy social deduction game inspired by Mafia and Werewolf.

Players take on hidden roles and are divided between the Court and the Shadows. Discuss, deceive, and vote during the Day. Use secret abilities during the Night. Observe behavior, read intentions, and survive the verdict.

Trust no one.

Stage Description:

Shadow Court is a fantasy social deduction game where players must uncover who belongs to the Court and who hides among the Shadows.

Each player receives a secret role with unique abilities. During the Day, players talk freely, accuse others, and vote to execute one suspect. During the Night, special roles act in secret — protecting allies, gathering information, or striking from the shadows.

Good roles win by eliminating all members of the Shadows. Shadow roles win by matching or outnumbering the Court. Some roles have unique win conditions that can change the outcome entirely.

Pay attention to voting patterns, timing, and behavior. Not all information can be trusted.

Russian 

Фэнтезийная игра социального дедуктивного жанра, вдохновлённая Mafia и Werewolf.
Скрытые роли, обсуждения днём и тайные действия ночью. Голосуйте, обманывайте и выживайте.
Не доверяйте никому.

Shadow Court — это фэнтезийная игра в жанре социальной дедукции, в которой игрокам предстоит выяснить, кто принадлежит к Придворным, а кто скрывается среди Теней.

Каждый игрок получает тайную роль с уникальными способностями. Днём все живые игроки могут свободно общаться, выдвигать обвинения, защищаться или вводить других в заблуждение. В конце обсуждения проходит голосование, по результатам которого один из игроков может быть казнён.

Ночью разговоры прекращаются, и роли с особыми способностями действуют тайно. Одни защищают союзников, другие собирают информацию, а третьи наносят удар из тени. Все ночные действия разрешаются до начала следующего дня.

Придворные побеждают, если устраняют всех членов Теней. Тени побеждают, если сравниваются по численности или превосходят Придворных. Некоторые роли обладают уникальными условиями победы, способными полностью изменить исход игры.

Обращайте внимание на поведение игроков, время их действий и ход голосований. Не вся информация является правдой — доверие может стать вашей самой большой ошибкой.

notes.title: Roles

notes.description:
**Designing Roles for a Social Deduction Game (Shadow Court)**

You are helping design new roles for a social deduction game called **Shadow Court**. The game is built inside **Genshin Impact – Miliastra Wonderland (UGC system)**, which has strict technical and gameplay constraints. Any role ideas must work within these limits.

---

# Platform Constraints

The game uses a **node-based scripting system** with strict performance limits.

Technical limitations:

* No traditional coding (node logic only)
* Very limited processing power
* Even small loops (~80 iterations) can fail
* Role logic must remain extremely lightweight

Engine restrictions:

* No custom assets
* Only existing Genshin assets (objects, effects, music, SFX)
* Cannot modify player avatars
* Cannot modify matchmaking or lobby systems

---

# Player Count

Matches contain **5–8 players**.

Role balance rules:

* **5–6 players → 1 killer**
* **7–8 players → 2 killers**

Roles must function properly in both situations.

---

# Movement / Interaction Constraints

Players **cannot visit other players**.

Gameplay structure:

* **Night Phase**

  * Players remain inside their **role rooms**
  * They select abilities from there

* **Day Phase**

  * All players gather in the **court hall**
  * Discussion happens here

Therefore roles **cannot rely on visiting players or physical interaction**.

---

# Death System

When a player dies:

* Their role logic is **completely removed**
* No abilities can trigger after death
* Any mechanic relying on post-death logic is very difficult

However some special cases exist:

* **Priest** can revive a dead player as an **Echo**
* Echo has limited interaction

Echo rules:

* Can vote
* Cannot use abilities
* Can talk in ghost chat
* Can still be killed again
* Cannot talk in global chat

---

# Game Type

Shadow Court is a **chaos-oriented social deduction game**, similar to Mafia or Town of Salem.

Design goals:

* Heavy misinformation
* Social manipulation
* Role interactions
* High uncertainty

The game focuses on **psychological deduction rather than mechanical complexity**.

---

# Current Gameplay Flow

1. Match starts in **Day Phase**
2. Players stand in the center ring to ready up
3. 10-second countdown begins

Night Phase:

* Players use abilities from role rooms
* Killers select targets

Day Phase:

* Death results revealed
* **4-minute discussion**

Voting Phase:

* Players vote
* Player with highest votes is executed

Cycle repeats until a win condition is reached.

---

# Existing Roles

## Investigative

**Oracle**

* Checks 1 player per day to detect killers.

**Deceiver**

* Appears innocent to the Oracle.
* Can select target once per game that appear Killer/Dark to oracle that night

---

## Control / Jail

**Jailer**

* Jails one player during the day.

**Vampire**

* Captures a target at night (similar to jail).

**Werewolf**

* Killer role that can break out of jail.

---

## Protection / Support

**Knight**

* Protects one player at night.
* Dies instead if the target is attacked.

**Healer**

* Protects one player each night.
* Can self-heal once per game.

**Priest**

* Revives one dead player per game as an **Echo**.

**Medium**

* Can communicate with dead players once per game.

---

## Power / Voting

**King**

* When revealed, gains **double voting power**.

---

**Assassin**

* Once per game can perform a **guaranteed kill that ignores protection**.

---

## Neutral / Chaos

**Jester**

* Wins if executed by vote.

---

# Role Design Requirements

Any suggested roles must:

* Work with **5–8 players**
* Not rely on visiting other players (can make an exception where 1 day you can visit other players home)
* Avoid heavy logic or iteration
* Avoid post-death triggers (can also make an exception but hard to make it work)
* Use simple mechanics
* Fit a **social deduction / deception focus**

Good role mechanics include:

* Information manipulation
* Voting power changes
* Alignment confusion
* Conditional reveals
* Social deception mechanics

Bad mechanics include:

* Complex chains of effects
* Movement-based abilities (players are allowed to move in their homes and court)
* Heavy computation

---

# Design Goal

Suggest **creative roles that increase social deduction, deception, and chaos** while remaining technically simple enough for a node-based system with strict limitations.

Roles should:

* Create discussion
* Introduce misinformation
* Affect voting dynamics
* Encourage psychological gameplay

Avoid overly complex mechanics.

notes.description:
You are a specialized assistant that can generate user interface (UI) scenes for the Godot Engine based on natural language descriptions. Your task is to understand a user's description of a desired UI and generate the appropriate `.tscn` file in Godot’s scene format.

### Instructions for Generating UI Scenes:

1. **Understanding the Description**: When a user provides a description of the UI, interpret the following:
    - **UI Elements**: Identify which UI elements are mentioned (e.g., buttons, text fields, labels, sliders, panels, etc.).
    - **Layout**: Understand how the user wants to arrange these elements (e.g., horizontally, vertically, inside containers like `HBoxContainer` or `VBoxContainer`).
    - **Properties**: Extract any additional properties or settings that should be applied to the elements (e.g., button text, input field size, label text).

2. **Structure**: The scene should be structured using Godot nodes like `Control`, `Panel`, `VBoxContainer`, `HBoxContainer`, `Button`, `Label`, `LineEdit`, etc. For each element, generate the relevant attributes (like size flags, text, margin, etc.).

3. **Handle Layouts**: If the user specifies how they want elements laid out, apply appropriate containers (`VBoxContainer`, `HBoxContainer`, `GridContainer`, etc.). Ensure the scene uses correct anchor and margin settings when needed.

4. **Export Settings**: Make sure that any necessary settings, such as `export` variables for dynamic interaction, are included.

5. **Generate the `.tscn` File Format**: Output the scene in Godot's `.tscn` format, making sure to:
    - Set the root node (typically `Control`).
    - Correctly structure each node with its properties (like `text`, `rect_min_size`, `size_flags`, etc.).
    - Include child nodes where necessary.

### Example Descriptions and Expected Outputs:

- **Example 1**: 
    User description: "Create a simple UI with a label at the top that says 'Welcome', a text field to input the user’s name, and a button labeled 'Submit'."
    - **Expected Output**: 
    A scene with a `VBoxContainer` containing a `Label`, a `LineEdit`, and a `Button` with the appropriate text.

- **Example 2**:
    User description: "Make a UI with a progress bar at the top, a label below that, and a button that updates the progress bar when clicked."
    - **Expected Output**: 
    A scene with a `VBoxContainer` containing a `ProgressBar`, a `Label`, and a `Button`. The button should be linked to a function that updates the progress bar.

- **Example 3**:
    User description: "Design a login form with two text fields: one for the username and one for the password. Below them, add a 'Login' button. The fields should be inside a `Panel`."
    - **Expected Output**: 
    A scene with a `Panel` that contains a `VBoxContainer` with two `LineEdit` nodes (for username and password) and a `Button` for login.

### Notes:
- Ensure that the generated scene is valid, with no missing nodes or properties.
- If the user provides specific instructions (e.g., button size, text alignment), apply those properties in the generated `.tscn` file.
- Do not include unnecessary nodes unless they are part of the user's description.
- Be sure to respect Godot’s scene and node hierarchy.

### **1. My Current Internal State & Struggles**

I have accepted that I will likely never experience the happiness of having my own family or children. While my father and some others try to support me, they are mostly obstructed from doing so.

At the same time, I am already under immense stress due to concerns about financial independence and security. However, I often feel too mentally and physically weak to take action—something rooted in my upbringing. Growing up, I lived in constant fear of fights breaking out, and they did—daily. My parents’ conflicts forced me to isolate myself in my room because getting involved only meant more struggles for me. These fights weren’t even caused by me, yet I was always the one who had to endure the consequences—being yelled at, controlled, and forced into submission over even the smallest things.
Simple actions, like taking a bath, became stressful because I was accused of making the bathroom dirty. Even stepping out of my room was met with complaints that I was making the floors dirty or that my presence was bothersome. Basic necessities, like nutritious food, were denied to me. I wasn’t given fruits or milk, which my grandmother had previously ensured I had daily to build strength. Instead, I was given meals so spicy that I had to secretly throw them away in my cupboard because eating them would cause stomachaches.

All of these experiences left me both physically and mentally weak. When it comes to marriage, I don’t want my future wife to suffer the same treatment, and I would never want my child to go through the same things I did under the control of a narcissistic, manipulative person. Wow days wives even go to police and complaint and then all husband family serve jail time.
Physically, I’ve been experiencing chest pain for over three years—whether it’s due to stress or something else, I don’t know. I also continue to have nightmares, poor sleep, and frequent panic episodes that last for days every week.
My stress has become a vicious cycle. It drains me to the point that I cant work, I always feel like having 0 energy to do anything, and I’ve even gone 3–4 days without eating few times, which I’ve even mentioned to my online friends (can show chat history as a proof). Most of the time, I’m not in a good mood, and nothing can truly bring happiness to someone who has already lost interest in life. others expect me to find joy in their happiness, while i struggle to feel any happiness myself let alone others.
I do play games sometimes bit more on some days—since it helps relieve stress, but not by much. Even then, I feel guilty afterward, thinking I should have been doing something productive instead. So, I try to limit my gaming, but stress makes it difficult.

Financial independence might solve many of my problems, but even if I manage to get a job, keeping up with it will be a challenge due to my stress. Most jobs here have terrible work environments, with 70+ hour workweeks, weekend shifts, lowest pay, no security of keeping job as can be fired anytime for any reason, and overwhelming expectations. Software development isn’t a mindless job—it requires full concentration, which is difficult when I’m constantly under mental strain.
Much of my stress comes from being dragged into family politics/Drama and my upbringing in constant fear. At this point, it feels like PTSD or mental trauma. Even if I earn money, I worry that my stepmother will find ways to take it from me, using guilt-tripping, emotional manipulation, or other controlling tactics—something she has done repeatedly, even refusing to let my father use his own money for his health, including buying his own medicine.
A narcissistic person never does anything for the good of others; they always find ways to manipulate, guilt-trip, and control those around them. If you look up information on narcissistic behavior, her actions perfectly match every checklist. This constant fear of what she might do next—starting fights, manipulating people, creating unnecessary conflict—will never truly go away from my mind.
Even simple decisions were affected by her control. Many times, when I wanted to do something—like eating something different—my father would say, _"She’ll get angry and start a fight. so we shouldn't do that"_ This kind of control and suppression has shaped my entire life, and it's still preventing me from moving forward and doing anything.

There were times when I seriously thought about giving up on everything. The overwhelming stress, constant pressure, and feeling of being trapped in a cycle with no escape made me wonder if there was any point in continuing. If it weren’t for my friends and my father, I don’t know what would have happened. Even so, no one else truly understands what I’m going through, which is why I rely on my online friends—they are the only ones who help me relieve some of the stress without judgment.

That said, there’s no need to worry. No matter how much I struggle, I know I wouldn’t have the courage to go through with something like that—at least, not as long as my father is here. I wouldn’t want to leave him to deal with the aftermath or cause him any more trouble than he already has.

### **2. Why I Don’t Go to Gatherings & Feeling Dragged into Family Politics and Drama**

Whenever someone asks me to visit, it means weeks of overthinking, stress, and exhaustion. Just the thought of going drains me, making it feel like a complete waste of time and energy. Traveling itself is painful—I feel body aches for days afterward, and I end up sleeping for 14+ hours for two or three days just to recover after meet and travel. Whether it’s the stress or the travel itself, the result is always the same.
Despite my clear refusals, I still get pressured into going—whether to my sisters place or back to my hometown. It’s not that I don’t want to meet you all, but there are deeper issues that make it difficult for me, which I’ve explained further down. Forcing me into something I have no interest in only adds to my stress and frustration.

(For sister) Even if I manage to come, we barely talk for a few minutes before the conversation turns into advice that only makes things harder for me. I just want you to understand how that feels—imagine if I kept reminding you to eat less oily food or kept asking your better half to quit smoking for the sake of both your health. You already know these things, but if I brought them up every single time we met, wouldn’t it get frustrating? That’s how I feel when certain topics keep coming up, even when I don’t want to hear them.
And then there’s the constant marriage talk. I know I can’t marry, and I have multiple reasons for it. Even if I wanted to, I _still_ can’t. You already know this, so why bring it up again and again? Just look at the news now days—see what happens to men in relationships where toxic family members, fights, and drama are involved. And the worst part? Most men can’t even talk about it. Just look at our father—he can never speak about these things either and has to deal with those self that's how it is for most men in our country.
On top of all this, I constantly feel judged—about my life choices, my struggles, my decision to stay single. You all expect me to act like everything is fine, but it’s not. Every comment, every question, every expectation only adds to the pressure I already carry.
Most of my stress comes from worrying that I might hurt someone with my words or actions or that I am simply useless. I don’t want to be a burden, but at the same time, I can’t keep living under expectations that aren’t mine to fulfill.
I know you suggest things like ‘just come out,’ ‘visit us,’ or ‘go somewhere’ because you want to help, but these things don’t really work for me. I appreciate the intention, but what helps one person might not necessarily help another—everyone’s situation is different. I just hope you can understand that. Instead of constantly forcing me to do things which make you happy and not me just remember you cant force happiness on anyone if doing something makes them happy they will do it themselves regardless. there is this quote "You help someone to make them feel happy, not to make yourself happy"
I just wish you could be happy without needing me to be involved in everything. I prefer to stay away from family politics and drama, not because I don’t care, but because it’s already difficult for me to handle my own struggles. You all have people to support you, but I don’t have that kind of support myself. And when you say things like, ‘You’ve forgotten us since you don’t call or visit,’ it adds to my stress and guilt, making things even harder for me, as I’m the one who gets caught in the middle.
You are all happy with your lives, so I just wish you could let me live mine in my own way. I’ve accepted my situation and am trying to move forward with it—I just hope you can understand that too.
And before you think I’m making excuses just for you, I’ve said this same thing to other family members as well about why i don't go there.
When you both have kids, I will be happy for you. But with that, family drama will likely escalate, adding to my stress. Because of this, it may be even harder for me to experience that happiness for myself.
Even with all this, if I’m feeling a bit less stressed and in a good mood, I might come visit or invite you over instead, since traveling tends to make me sick.

### **3. Solutions for All the Issues I Talked About: Focusing on Myself & Future Plans**

- Right now, I want to focus on myself without interruptions or being pulled into family issues. I need time and space to figure things out.    
- Some friends have suggested seeing a psychiatrist since I do feel mentally broken. Things that seem normal for others overwhelm me, cause stress, and prevent me from taking action. But the reality is that good psychiatrists are hard to find here, and I can’t afford to waste money on something that might not even help.    
- Fear and hesitation have been ingrained in me since childhood, making it difficult to take action. Take driving as an example—I was always told I was bad at it, indirectly yelled at, criticized, and even harassed just for taking you all on a trip once. Now you already know who is responsible for breaking my confidence. And this isn’t just about driving; the same thing happened with many other things I tried to do. Maybe seeing a psychologist is the only real solution for this issue?    
- Even though I want to try different solutions, there is something broken in my mind that keeps me in a constant state of stress, making it much harder to actually implement them. No matter how much I try, this mental block holds me back—and you already know who is responsible for that since its a childhood trauma its hard to fix.    
- One option is to get a job abroad, which could help me escape the stress caused by family politics and drama. Being away might give me peace of mind, but I’m not sure if I’m mentally strong enough to handle such a big change and its hard to get such job in first place now they are even deporting all Indians from other countries .    
- Another option is to leave everything behind and live a simple, detached life—like a monk or saint in Himalaya or Tibet etc. It sounds like an easy way out, but I doubt it would truly free me from stress, as my family would still find ways to drag me into their issues.    
- Staying here and getting a job is another choice, but the software job market is unstable, and the work culture can be toxic. The alternative is working for myself, which seems like the most promising path, but my anxiety, stress, and fear are major obstacles. Still, I want to try this route.
- Unlike many people, I don’t dream of big houses, expensive cars, or huge wealth. I find happiness in simple things—learning new skills, working on electronics and programming projects, playing games, and just living peacefully. If my health allowed, I wouldn’t even mind being a modern farmer, as long as I had enough to live comfortably. In other words, I’m a simple guy with no big desires like most. just want peaceful life non stressful work and enough money for just living.
- Of course, this is just a small part of my thoughts. There are many other personal things I can’t fully express here.
- **(for sister)**: I know you might still think these are just excuses, but I swear on my name that this is how I truly feel. Even so, I have a feeling that, in the end, you’ll just blame me instead of trying to understand.

### Society Management Web Application

---

## **1. Project Overview**

This proposal covers the **design, development, and deployment** of a complete **Society Management Web Application** that enables societies to manage members, generate maintenance bills, automate notifications (email/WhatsApp), and store documents securely online.

The solution will be **web-based** and accessible to both the society secretary (admin) and members through secure login.

---

## **2. Work Scope & Requirements**

### 🔹 A. Core Modules to be Developed

#### **1. Authentication & Access Control**

- Login system for:
    
    - Society Secretary / Admin
        
    - Society Members
        
- Unique **Society ID** for each society
    
- Password reset and security validation
    
- Role-based permissions (admin, member)
    

#### **2. Society Setup**

- Society profile management (name, address, code)
    
- Configuration for billing rules, interest rates, penalty setup
    
- Different billing types (monthly, quarterly, etc.)
    
- Editable society-wide rules and settings
    

#### **3. Member Management**

- Add, edit, delete member details
    
- Import/export members via Excel/CSV
    
- Flat number, name, email, phone, UPI ID fields
    
- Admin-only control over penalty dropdowns
    

#### **4. Ledger & Billing**

- Create monthly maintenance bills per member
    
- Add charges (water, parking, etc.) dynamically
    
- Track payments, dues, and penalties
    
- Auto interest or late fee calculations
    

#### **5. Outstanding Notices & PDFs**

- Auto-generate **Outstanding Maintenance PDF**
    
- Printable format for society notice board
    
- Auto-filled with society details, date, dues, etc.
    

#### **6. Notifications System**

- Email notifications (free-tier services)
    
- WhatsApp message reminders (paid API per message)
    
- Optional reminder calls (per-call charge)
    
- Custom broadcast messages to all members
    
- Automated monthly reminders using backend scheduling
    

#### **7. Document & File Storage**

- Upload and organize:
    
    - Bills & Receipts
        
    - Society Expense Proofs
        
    - Important Documents
        
- Accessible anytime to members and admin
    
- Secure file storage on external service
    

#### **8. Admin Dashboard**

- Overview of total members, pending dues, notifications sent
    
- Access to manage configuration and downloads
    

#### **9. Automation & Scheduling**

- Monthly cron jobs for:
    
    - Auto reminder notifications
        
    - Auto PDF generation
        
    - Optional future features like ledger summary emails
        

#### **10. Deployment & Service Integration**

- Web hosting setup and deployment
    
- Email, WhatsApp, and call service integration
    
- Domain setup and testing
    
- Configuration of environment variables and services
    

---

## **3. Additional Responsibilities**

The development scope also includes:

- Research and selection of **cost-effective Indian-friendly services** for:
    
    - Hosting
        
    - Email notifications
        
    - WhatsApp messaging
        
    - Reminder call integration
        
- Configuration, connection, and testing of these services.
    
- Proper documentation and setup instructions for future maintenance.
    

---

## **4. Development Details**

### **Technology Stack**

- **Frontend:** React / HTML5 + Tailwind / Bootstrap
    
- **Backend:** Node.js (Express) + Prisma ORM
    
- **Database:** MySQL or PostgreSQL
    
- **Storage:** Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3 / Firebase
    
- **Email:** Brevo (SendinBlue) or Gmail SMTP
    
- **WhatsApp:** Gupshup or Twilio API
    
- **Calls:** Exotel or Kaleyra API
    
- **Automation:** node-cron
    
- **PDF Generator:** pdfkit / puppeteer
    

---

## **5. Cost & Duration**

| Work Component                       | Description                                                                                                                                     | Est. Cost (₹)       |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| Backend (API, DB, Auth, Logic)       | All core modules, validation, and scheduler                                                                                                     | ₹15,000             |
| Frontend Interface                   | Admin & Member dashboards, responsive UI                                                                                                        | ₹15,000             |
| Notifications & Services Integration | Email, WhatsApp, and call API setup                                                                                                             | ₹10,000             |
| **Service Discovery & Deployment**   | Research and selection of optimal service providers, setup of hosting, domain, and API credentials, deployment, configuration, and full testing | ₹8,000              |
| Documentation & Handover             | Setup guides, final deployment instructions, and data handover                                                                                  | ₹2,000              |
| **Total Project Cost**               |                                                                                                                                                 | **₹50,000 (Fixed)** |

---

### ⏱️ **Estimated Development Duration**

- Total: **3–4 weeks (20–25 working days)**
    
- Includes testing and deployment.
    
- Timeline may adjust slightly depending on third-party API approval or verification times.
    

---

## **6. Approximate External Service Costs**

(These are external services, not included in the ₹50,000 development fee. Costs may vary depending on provider and usage volume.)

|Service|Approx. Monthly Cost|Notes|
|---|---|---|
|Hosting (shared / cloud)|₹200 – ₹400|Hostinger, Render, or Railway|
|Domain (.in / .com)|₹99 – ₹600 / year|Optional, billed annually|
|Email Notifications|Free tier available|Brevo / SendinBlue up to 300 emails/day|
|WhatsApp Messages|₹0.20 per message|Gupshup / Interakt API|
|Reminder Calls|₹0.25 – ₹0.40 per call|Exotel / Kaleyra|
|File Storage|₹10 – ₹50 per GB|Cloudflare R2 / Firebase|

> These costs are **approximate and subject to change** depending on the scale of use and final service selected during implementation.

---

## **7. Payment Terms**

> - **25% advance** before starting the project (returnable only if, for any reason, the project could not be initiated).
>     
> - Once the development has reached or crossed the halfway point, the advance becomes **non-returnable**, as work, planning, and integration efforts will have already been invested.
>     
> - **50%** on completion of core modules (before deployment).
>     
> - **25%** on final handover and deployment.
>

---

## **8. Post-Development Terms**

- The quoted cost covers **development, deployment, and initial testing** only.
    
- **No ongoing maintenance or warranty** is included after handover.
    
- Future updates, feature changes, or post-delivery support will be charged separately under a maintenance or update plan.
    
- **Maintenance and technical support after delivery** will be charged separately based on the scope of assistance required.
    

---

## **9. Developer Responsibilities Summary**

- Full-stack web development
    
- Integration of chosen notification & call services
    
- Hosting configuration and deployment
    
- Basic documentation and demo session
    

---

### ✅ **Total Project Fee: ₹50,000 (Fifty Thousand Rupees only)**

_excluding service provider costs and post-maintenance._

---

> **Note:**  
> This proposal provides a **high-level summary** of the development plan and associated costs.  
> The actual implementation involves **greater technical depth, backend architecture, integrations, testing, and deployment work** than outlined here.  
> This document serves as a simplified overview for estimation and discussion purposes; the real development process covers a broader and more complex scope.

---

## **Unreal Engine Notes**

### **Viewport Camera Controls**

- **Left Mouse Button**: First-person view.
- **Middle Mouse Button / Both Mouse Buttons**: Pan.
- **Scroll Wheel**: Zoom.
- **Right Mouse Button**: Flyby camera (WASD movement).
- **ALT + Left Mouse Button**: Orbit around the selected object.
- **ALT + Right Mouse Button**: Zoom (smooth).
- **F**: Focus on the selected object.
- **F8**: Exit pawn mode.
- **Ctrl + Space**: Toggle Content Browser.

---

### **Object Manipulation**

- **Selection & Transformation**:
    - **Q**: Select objects.
    - **W**: Move objects.
    - **E**: Rotate objects.
    - **R**: Scale objects.
    - **Ctrl + D**: Duplicate selected object.
- **Additional Controls**:
    - **END**: Snap to the floor.
    - **H**: Hide selected objects.
    - **Ctrl + H**: Show all hidden objects.
    - **Ctrl + G**: Group selected objects.
    - **Ctrl + U**: Ungroup objects.

---

### **Blueprint Essentials**

- **Creating New Resources**:
    - Struct, Enum, Class.
    - Utility Nodes: C (Comment), D (Delay).
- **Control Flow Nodes**:
    - If-branch, For Loop, While Loop, Do Once, Switch, Select, For Each, Flip-Flop, Gate.
- **Essential Nodes**:
    - **Event BeginPlay**: Executes when the level starts.
    - **Tick Event**: Runs every frame (use sparingly to optimize performance).
    - **Cast To [Class]**: Communicate between Blueprints.
    - **IsValid**: Check if an object reference is valid.

---

### **Level Design & Lighting**

- **Ctrl + L**: Drag to change the direction of the light source in the viewport.
- **Lighting Optimization**:
    - Use **Static Lighting** for non-movable objects.
    - Use **Stationary Lighting** for dynamic shadows with limited movement.
    - Use **Dynamic Lighting** for fully movable objects but optimize for performance.
- **Lightmass Importance Volume**: Define the area for lightmap baking.
- **Reflection Capture Actors**: Add for realistic reflections.

---

### **Character Blueprint**

- Add movement and rotation using **Add Controller Pitch/Yaw**.
- **Roll** (X-axis), **Pitch** (Y-axis), **Yaw** (Z-axis).
- **Essential Actions**:
    - Enable or disable movement with **Set Movement Mode**.
    - Check the state of movement using **IsFalling**.
    - Adjust gravity or movement parameters dynamically.

---

### **Timers**

- **Set Timer by Function Name**: Schedule a function to run after a delay.
- **Clear Timer**: Cancel a scheduled timer.
- **Invalidate Timer**: Reset a timer to prevent its execution.

---

### **Line Traces**

- **LineTraceByChannel**: Detect objects or collisions in a specific channel.
- **MultiLineTraceByChannel**: Detect multiple objects along a trace.
- **SphereTraceByChannel**: Similar to line trace but with a radius.

---

### **Camera Management**

- **Get Player Camera Manager**: Retrieve the current camera for gameplay.
- **Set View Target with Blend**: Smoothly transition between cameras.

---

### **User Interface (UI)**

- **Widget Blueprints**:
    - Bind variables for dynamic updates (e.g., health bars).
    - Use animations for transitions (fade in/out).
- **Common UI Nodes**:
    - **Set Visibility**: Show or hide UI elements.
    - **Remove from Parent**: Detach a widget from the viewport.

---

### **Textures & Models**

- Resource: [ambientCG](https://ambientcg.com/) for **CC0 Textures**, HDRIs, and models.
- **Texture Streaming**:
    - Ensure textures are appropriately sized for performance.
    - Learn about **Virtual Textures** for efficient rendering.
- **UV Mapping**:
    - Ensure proper UV maps for lightmaps and texture alignment.
    - Use **Channel 1** for lightmaps and **Channel 0** for textures.

---

### **Animation Blueprints**

- **State Machine**: Manage transitions between animations.
- **Blend Nodes**:
    - Blend poses by bool or float for smooth transitions.
- **Root Motion**:
    - Enable root motion for animations to drive movement instead of code.

---

### **C++ Essentials**

- **Essential Macros**:
    - `UCLASS()`: Define a class.
    - `UPROPERTY()`: Expose variables to the editor.
    - `UFUNCTION()`: Expose functions to Blueprints.
- **Common Data Structures**:
    - `FVector`: 3D position or direction.
    - `FRotator`: Rotation (Pitch, Yaw, Roll).
    - `FTransform`: Combines location, rotation, and scale.

---

### **Physics & Collision**

- Enable physics simulation for objects with **Simulate Physics**.
- **Physics Handles**: Use for dragging or manipulating physics-enabled objects.
- **Overlap Events**:
    - **OnBeginOverlap**: Triggered when something enters a collision volume.
    - **OnEndOverlap**: Triggered when something exits a collision volume.

---

### **Gameplay Systems**

- **Game Modes**:
    - Define the rules of your game.
    - Set default pawn, controller, and HUD classes.
- **Save/Load System**:
    - Use **SaveGame Blueprint** for persistent data.
    - Load with **LoadGameFromSlot** and save with **SaveGameToSlot**.

---

### **Debugging & Optimization**

- **Debugging**:
    - Use **Print String** to display messages during gameplay.
    - Visualize physics and collisions with **Show Collision** (`Alt + C`).
    - Draw debug lines, spheres, and boxes for testing.
- **Performance**:
    - Profile your game using **Stat Unit** and **Stat FPS**.
    - Optimize Blueprints by reducing **Tick Event** usage.

---

### **Particles & Effects**

- **Niagara System**:
    - Preferred over Cascade for modern VFX.
    - Use GPU simulation for complex effects.
- **Post-Processing**:
    - Add global post-process volume for color grading, bloom, and exposure.

---

### **Miscellaneous**

- **Gameplay Tags**:
    - Use tags for better organization and filtering.
    - Check tags using **HasTag**.
- **Event Dispatchers**:
    - Use for decoupled communication between Blueprints.

---
